title: Environmental/Genre Skin Pack Materialization
objective: Materialize the five UISK-13 environmental/genre Skin Packs through the completed UISR runtime so the application itself—not background art—can feel aquatic, orbital, ruined, cartoon-surreal or biologically alien while preserving one shared behavior/accessibility contract.

included: materialize Underwater Reef, Space, Post-Apocalyptic, Unreal-Zone Cartoon and Alien Swamp as registry-available Skin Packs

implement environmental presentation definitions across materials, frames, typography/numerals, motifs, bounded effects/atmosphere, shared components and specialized surfaces using existing UISR seams
prove each pack remains recognizable with hero/background art removed and across hero, ordinary utility and dense-data modes

preserve semantic behavior, screen/workflow identity, focus/navigation/task topology, permissions/hidden-information projection, validation/provenance/AI semantics, combat/action authority and responsive task transformation
preserve application-wide accessibility and reading-assistance preferences with high-contrast/reduced-motion/reduced-transparency/reduced-distraction/static fallbacks
prove Underwater Reef versus Alien Swamp, Space versus Cyberpunk/Rainbow, Post-Apocalyptic versus Patchwork and Unreal-Zone versus ordinary colorful theming remain structurally distinct
focused UISR-08 tests and exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation
excluded: extreme/social/craft target pack materialization reserved for UISR-09
Tier-C release packaging, measured performance proof and destructive legacy cleanup reserved for UISR-10
application behavior/task geometry changes, hidden-information-derived atmosphere, gameplay/permission/navigation/validation/provenance/AI authority
scope.completion_gate: All five environmental/genre packs are runtime-available, recognizable without background art in hero/utility/dense contexts, mutually distinct along their required comparison boundaries, and preserve shared semantics/accessibility with static safe fallbacks.

selection_boundaries: UISR-08 is selected by verified UISR-07 closeout but has no implementation authority until a later owner Continue.
Environmental identity must come from reusable UI construction rather than scenery alone.
Atmosphere is optional and may never carry state, availability, focus, permission, target legality or hidden information.
The ui-implementation lane remains parallel to product-development and may not pause or rewrite product work.
Application publication remains serialized by the OPS3 merge lease and requires stale-base revalidation if another lane publishes first.
next_action: Create focused UISR-08 RED tests on application base b217074bb9fe318a12f96e4e1517b4caff9fb5ac for five-pack availability, no-background identity in hero/utility/dense modes, accessibility-safe static fallbacks, required cross-pack distinction and hidden-data-safe environmental atmosphere; then implement only bounded presentation definitions and validate exact-head cross-platform.
